title: A log collector
hints: Give every client its own buffer and its own "connected" flag. `received` is the deframing loop of lesson 2.03, with two extra checks as soon as the header (and the level byte) are available.
The order across clients falls out naturally if you append each record to one shared list at the moment it completes.
requirements: Records are reassembled per client however the bytes are split, and interleaved across clients in completion order.
Bad lengths and levels disconnect only the offending client.
Partial records at disconnect are dropped and counted.
Draining filters by level and empties the collector.
stretch: Make it real: a named pipe server with an accept loop and a thread per client (lesson 2.04) feeding a `LogCollector` protected by a mutex, and a small test program that starts five helpers which each send a hundred records.
